title: Plus Jakarta Sans is the primary UI font across body, labels, inputs, tables, KPI numbers, and it is actually loaded (package, font link, or local file).
Serif is reserved for page titles and subtitles; no more than 4 families with distinct roles; no monospace in inputs, filters, or labels.
Hero and KPI numerals are bold or extra bold with tabular lining figures; units such as % are smaller and muted.
Secondary text is at least 12px, none below 11px, and its gray has enough contrast.
Clear type scale: page title, then card title, then body, then caption; uppercase only for table headers.
Brand palette (navy, red, yellow), light-blue page background, white cards, cool neutral grays.
Status colors are consistent across donut, KPI icons, bars, and pills, and defined in one place.
Colors come from theme tokens or CSS variables, not scattered hex literals; no pure black text.
No off-palette hues for statuses; red reserved for overdue and error.
Text and status chips meet WCAG AA contrast.
Rounded corners (about 12 to 16px), slim border, soft shadow, identical on every card.
Related information is grouped in one card, cards in a row have equal heights, padding is consistent.
Page header sits on the background, not in a card; all filters live in one card.
Summary-first structure: hero metric on the left, KPIs in the middle, breakdown on the right, in one row above the main list.
Grid with consistent gutters and aligned edges; graceful wrap below about 1280px.
The main table is visible close to the fold and cards have no large dead space.
Page header has a large navy title and a scope subtitle; the screen's purpose is clear.
KPI cards have a tinted icon circle, semibold title, large number, % of total at one decimal, a 'View list ->' link, and the whole card is clickable.
Donut is large with a thick ring, a centered number whose unit is smaller, a label, a caption, and a legend (or KPI cards acting as the legend).
Breakdown bars show stacked status segments with 'x of y' text and a legend, not bare totals.
Numbers are consistent between chart, KPI, and table; rounding sums sensibly.
Small uppercase muted headers with sort indicators and per-column filter icons; no always-visible filter input row.
Status is a soft pill with a dot, using the status tokens.
Primary-link first column, muted secondary columns, trailing row action, hover highlight.
Hairline dividers, generous row height, no redundant columns or pills, '—' for empty values.
Sticky header, count and pagination, one consistent date format.
One filter card, labels above, rounded fields with solid slim borders in the UI font, locked fields marked with an icon.
One clear secondary action (outlined navy), Reset as a ghost button, enabled and disabled states are distinguishable.
Large click targets, grouped actions, familiar patterns (Fitts, Hick, Jakob).
Loading, empty, success, and error states exist for the main screens.
Visible keyboard focus and aria-label on icon-only buttons.
Layout holds at 1366px width.
